verdict.rationale: Typesense is open-source and can be self-hosted via Docker, Kubernetes, binaries, or packages on any infrastructure the user controls, which inherently lets an AI-native user choose exactly where data resides (typesense-docs-5, typesense-docs-26, typesense-probe-rt-1). However, the evidence pack has no explicit mention of region selection within Typesense Cloud's hosted offering (no docs on choosing a cloud region/data residency guarantees), so the story is only partially evidenced for the managed SaaS path. Missing for 10: explicit Typesense Cloud region-selection/data-residency documentation, and any compliance certifications (e.g., GDPR data-locality statements).
